children: Veranda Learning Solutions said in an exchange filing on Tuesday that its Promoters — Kalpathi S Aghoram, Kalpathi S Ganesh and Kalpathi S Suresh — have executed an unattested pledge agreement with Authum Investment & Infrastructure Ltd for creation of a pledge over equity shares of Veranda Learning held by them.

“The agreement is for ₹111 crore loan availed by the promoters in their personal capacity from the lender, by way of creation of a first-ranking and exclusive pledge over certain equity shares of Veranda Learning held by the promoters,” an exchange notification said.  It is security for credit facilities availed by them in personal capacity.

Veranda Learning is not a party to the Unattested Pledge Agreement, the company added. However, Authum is a significant shareholder of the company, holding 10.8 per cent of the paid-up equity share capital as on September 18, 2026, and is therefore a ‘related party’.

“The execution of the Unattested Pledge Agreement does not, by itself, have any impact on the management or control of the company. As is customary in financing arrangements involving a pledge of shares, invocation or enforcement of the pledge by the lender upon the occurrence of events specified in the relevant transaction documents may have a consequential impact on the shareholding pattern of the company. However, such impact would arise only in the event of enforcement in accordance with the agreed terms,”  Veranda Learning added.

title: Veranda Learning promoters pledge shares for ₹111 crore credit
